timeline.tweet: Izuku followed her at a slow jog. Nerves filled his stomach as he neared closer. The sound of soft piano music began to fill his ears causing him to smile. He was going to get married today. He was going to get married to a man he had loved since he was a small child.

“Ready?” Ochako asked as Izuku neared closer, a small ring clasped between her fingers. Izukus flustered state reminded herself on her wedding day. Marrying her wife was the best thing she’d ever done in her life and she wanted her best friend to experience that too.

Izuku smiled bashfully, “thank you Kacchan.” That was the last words the both of them spoke until the end of their marriage was completed. Izuku waited impatiently for those last 6 words to come out of the priest mouth. It seemed like forever until his wish became true.
